list.name: env
list.label: Env
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "k6_summaries", tag: "env", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "test_summary", start: -180d)

list.name: test_name
list.label: Test
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "k6_summaries", tag: "test_name", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "test_summary" and r.env == "${env}", start: -180d)

list.name: left
list.label: Left run
list.query:
all = from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}" and r._field == "requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.testid}))

a = all |> limit(n: 1, offset: 1)
b = all |> limit(n: 1)
c = all |> limit(n: 100000, offset: 2)
union(tables: [a, b, c]) |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

list.name: right
list.label: Right run
list.query:
all = from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}" and r._field == "requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.testid}))

all |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Last 20 runs: pick Left and Right
panels.description: Click Set as Left or Set as Right to compare that run; the other side stays as it is. Compared marks the runs in the current comparison. Click a run id to open it on the run dashboard.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid"})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(testid|requests|failed|duration_ms|avg|min|max|p90|p95|p99|rps|error_rate)$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "testid", "duration_ms", "requests", "failed", "avg", "p95", "p99", "rps", "error_rate"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with from_ms: int(v: r._time) / 1000000 - 5000, to_ms: int(v: r._time) / 1000000 + int(v: r.duration_ms) + 5000}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
      compared: if r.testid == "${left}" then "Left" else if r.testid == "${right}" then "Right" else "",
      set_left: "Set as Left", set_right: "Set as Right"}))

data = from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "endpoint_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}" and r._field == "requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid", request_name: "endpoint"})
  |> keep(columns: ["endpoint", "testid"])

lt = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${left}")
  |> group(columns: ["endpoint"]) |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({endpoint: r.endpoint, side: 1}))
rt = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${right}")
  |> group(columns: ["endpoint"]) |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({endpoint: r.endpoint, side: 2}))

presence = union(tables: [lt, rt])
  |> group(columns: ["endpoint"])
  |> sum(column: "side")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({endpoint: r.endpoint, presence: if r.side == 3 then "Both" else if r.side == 1 then "Only in Left" else "Only in Right"}))

presence |> filter(fn: (r) => r.presence == "Both") |> group() |> count(column: "endpoint")

import "math"
import "array"

data = from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid"})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(testid|requests|failed|duration_ms|avg|min|max|p90|p95|p99|rps|error_rate)$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()

lrec = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${left}") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
rrec = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${right}") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

array.from(rows: [
  {metric: "min", left: lrec.min, right: rrec.min},
  {metric: "avg", left: lrec.avg, right: rrec.avg},
  {metric: "p90", left: lrec.p90, right: rrec.p90},
  {metric: "p95", left: lrec.p95, right: rrec.p95},
  {metric: "p99", left: lrec.p99, right: rrec.p99},
  {metric: "max", left: lrec.max, right: rrec.max}
])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with left: math.round(x: r.left), right: math.round(x: r.right)}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with delta: r.right - r.left, delta_pct: if r.left > 0.0 then (r.right - r.left) / r.left * 100.0 else 0.0}))

import "math"
import "array"

data = from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid"})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(testid|requests|failed|duration_ms|avg|min|max|p90|p95|p99|rps|error_rate)$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()

lrec = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${left}") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
rrec = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${right}") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

array.from(rows: [
  {metric: "Requests", left: float(v: lrec.requests), right: float(v: rrec.requests)},
  {metric: "Failed", left: float(v: lrec.failed), right: float(v: rrec.failed)},
  {metric: "Error rate (%)", left: lrec.error_rate * 100.0, right: rrec.error_rate * 100.0},
  {metric: "RPS (req/s)", left: lrec.rps, right: rrec.rps},
  {metric: "Duration (s)", left: lrec.duration_ms / 1000.0, right: rrec.duration_ms / 1000.0}
])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      scale = if r.metric == "Requests" or r.metric == "Failed" then 1.0 else 10.0
      return {r with left: math.round(x: r.left * scale) / scale, right: math.round(x: r.right * scale) / scale, scale: scale}
  })
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with delta: math.round(x: (r.right - r.left) * r.scale) / r.scale, delta_pct: if r.left > 0.0 then (r.right - r.left) / r.left * 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      better = if r.metric == "Requests" or r.metric == "RPS (req/s)" then r.delta > 0.0 else r.delta < 0.0
      return {r with style: if r.delta == 0.0 then "{}"
          else if better then "{\"color\": \"#73BF69\"}" else "{\"color\": \"#F2495C\"}"}
  })

panels.title: Latency ${lat_pct} by endpoint
panels.description: Left and right ${lat_pct} of every endpoint present in both runs, with the change.

targets.query:
import "math"
data = from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "endpoint_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid", request_name: "endpoint"})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(${lat_pct}|error_rate|rps|testid)$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "endpoint"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "endpoint", "testid", "${lat_pct}", "error_rate", "rps"])
  |> rename(fn: (column) => if column == "${lat_pct}" then "lat" else column)
  |> group()

lt = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${left}") |> keep(columns: ["endpoint", "lat", "error_rate", "rps"])
  |> rename(columns: {lat: "lat_l", error_rate: "err_l", rps: "rps_l"})
rt = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${right}") |> keep(columns: ["endpoint", "lat", "error_rate", "rps"])
  |> rename(columns: {lat: "lat_r", error_rate: "err_r", rps: "rps_r"})

join(tables: {l: lt, r: rt}, on: ["endpoint"])
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with lat_l: math.round(x: r.lat_l), lat_r: math.round(x: r.lat_r)}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
      lat_d: r.lat_r - r.lat_l,
      lat_pct: if r.lat_l > 0.0 then (r.lat_r - r.lat_l) / r.lat_l * 100.0 else 0.0,
      err_d: (r.err_r - r.err_l) * 100.0,
      rps_pct: if r.rps_l > 0.0 then (r.rps_r - r.rps_l) / r.rps_l * 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["endpoint"])

data = from(bucket: "k6_summaries")
  |> range(start: -180d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "endpoint_summary" and r.test_name == "${test_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${env}")
  |> rename(columns: {test_id: "testid", request_name: "endpoint"})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^(p95|error_rate|rps|testid)$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "endpoint"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "endpoint", "testid", "p95", "error_rate", "rps"])
  |> rename(fn: (column) => if column == "p95" then "lat" else column)
  |> group()

lt = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${left}") |> keep(columns: ["endpoint", "lat", "error_rate", "rps"])
  |> rename(columns: {lat: "lat_l", error_rate: "err_l", rps: "rps_l"})
rt = data |> filter(fn: (r) => r.testid == "${right}") |> keep(columns: ["endpoint", "lat", "error_rate", "rps"])
  |> rename(columns: {lat: "lat_r", error_rate: "err_r", rps: "rps_r"})

join(tables: {l: lt, r: rt}, on: ["endpoint"])
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with rps_l: math.round(x: r.rps_l * 10.0) / 10.0, rps_r: math.round(x: r.rps_r * 10.0) / 10.0}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
      lat_d: r.lat_r - r.lat_l,
      lat_pct: if r.lat_l > 0.0 then (r.lat_r - r.lat_l) / r.lat_l * 100.0 else 0.0,
      err_d: (r.err_r - r.err_l) * 100.0,
      rps_pct: if r.rps_l > 0.0 then (r.rps_r - r.rps_l) / r.rps_l * 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["endpoint"])
